comment: A selective bilingual guide to representative interfaces. code_registry.json remains the module inventory; this overlay supplies workflow grouping, public ownership names and usage descriptions.

nodes.label: StructureGraph

description.en: Authoritative 2D/3D geometry, stable node/edge identities, and stored provenance.
description.zh: 统一保存二维、三维几何、稳定节点与边 ID 及来源信息。

input.en: Dimension, tolerance, nodes and physical edges.
input.zh: 维度、合并容差、节点和物理边。

output.en: One StructureGraph reused by downstream adapters.
output.zh: 供下游接口复用的 StructureGraph。

caveat.en: Geometry storage does not select a physical model or convert units.
caveat.zh: 保存几何不等于选择物理模型，也不会自动换算单位。

nodes.example:
import fibernet as fn

graph = fn.pattern_2d(
    unit="honeycomb", box=(10, 10), grid=(2, 2), radius=0.05, seed=23
)

description.en: Build a planar unit, transform it, and tile the resulting graph.
description.zh: 构建平面基元，变换并平铺为结构图。

input.en: Unit or points, box, grid, radius, material, seed.
input.zh: 基元名称或点列、尺寸、网格数、半径、材料、随机种子。

output.zh: 二维 StructureGraph。

caveat.en: n_pts_per_side creates graph nodes; n_internal stores edge interior points. With custom points, fit_to_box=True requires n_pts_per_side=0 and point_displacements set to None, an empty list/tuple, or an empty (0, 2) array. To add intermediate nodes or displacements, fit the source points explicitly first, then use fit_to_box=False.
caveat.zh: n_pts_per_side 生成图节点；n_internal 保存边内点。自定义 points 使用 fit_to_box=True 时，要求 n_pts_per_side=0，point_displacements 为 None、空列表、空元组或形状为 (0, 2) 的空数组。若需添加中间节点或位移，请先显式缩放源点，再使用 fit_to_box=False。

description.en: Build and tile a registered three-dimensional unit.
description.zh: 构建并平铺已注册的三维基元。

input.en: 3D unit, box, grid, radius, material and seed.
input.zh: 三维基元、尺寸、网格数、半径、材料和随机种子。

output.zh: 三维 StructureGraph。

caveat.en: HCP/TPMS post-tile repairs are recorded; they do not certify mechanical stability.
caveat.zh: HCP、TPMS 平铺后的连接修复有单独记录，不代表力学稳定性已验证。

description.en: Generate the finite closed FCC nearest-neighbor graph defined by v1.
description.zh: 按 v1 定义生成有限、闭边界的 FCC 最近邻结构图。

input.en: a and radius in m, integer grid, Material.
input.zh: 以米为单位的 a 与半径、整数网格数、Material。

output.zh: 采用 SI 米制的版本化 StructureGraph。

caveat.en: Distinct from the historical pattern_3d(unit='octet') geometry.
caveat.zh: 与历史 pattern_3d(unit='octet') 几何定义不同。

description.en: Register a callable factory for the 2D pattern namespace.
description.zh: 将可调用的二维基元工厂加入 pattern 名称表。

input.en: Name and callable factory.
input.zh: 名称和可调用的基元工厂。

output.zh: 更新后的名称表供 pattern_2d 使用。

caveat.en: Existing valid names may be replaced; this is not a solver registry.
caveat.zh: 允许替换已有名称；这不是求解器注册表。

description.en: Tile an existing unit graph while retaining independent parallel fibers.
description.zh: 平铺已有基元图，保留独立的平行物理纤维。

input.en: Unit StructureGraph, grid, box size and tolerance.
input.zh: 基元 StructureGraph、网格数、尺寸和容差。

output.zh: 节点焊接后的平铺 StructureGraph。

caveat.en: Shared fibers merge only when physical records and oriented geometry agree.
caveat.zh: 只有物理记录与有向几何匹配时才合并共享纤维。

description.en: Read and maintain the existing key-to-cell JSON format.
description.zh: 读写现有的“名称—基元”JSON 格式。

input.en: Registry path and validated CustomCell records.
input.zh: 注册文件路径和有效 CustomCell 记录。

output.zh: 命名基元；通过 CustomCell.to_graph() 生成几何。

caveat.en: Stored cell names are not automatically root-package exports.
caveat.zh: 保存的基元名称不会自动变成包根目录的 API。

description.en: Store a junction position, stable ID, face flags and metadata.
description.zh: 保存节点坐标、稳定 ID、边界面标记和元数据。

input.en: Position, node_id, six boundary flags, metadata.
input.zh: 坐标、node_id、六个边界面标记和元数据。

output.zh: StructureGraph 中的节点记录。

caveat.en: Boundary flags describe geometric faces, not mechanical supports.
caveat.zh: 边界标记描述几何面，不是力学支座约束。

description.en: Store endpoints, stable edge ID, radius, material and interior geometry.
description.zh: 保存端点、稳定边 ID、半径、材料和边内几何。

input.en: Endpoint IDs, radius, Material, internal_points and segments.
input.zh: 端点 ID、半径、Material、internal_points 与 segments。

output.en: Physical-edge record; parallel edges can remain distinct.
output.zh: 物理边记录；平行边可以保留独立身份。

caveat.en: Stored curve points do not establish curved-beam support in every solver.
caveat.zh: 保存曲线内点不代表所有求解器都支持曲梁。

description.en: Describe mechanical, thermal and electrical material properties.
description.zh: 记录力学、热学和电学材料属性。

input.en: Named properties such as E, density and conductivity.
input.zh: E、密度、电导率等带有物理含义的属性。

output.en: Material record attached to edges or used by explicit adapters.
output.zh: 可附于边或传入明确接口的 Material 记录。

caveat.en: Graph material records do not silently supply FEM modulus, spring coefficients or conductance.
caveat.zh: 图中的材料记录不会自动提供 FEM 模量、弹簧系数或边电导。

description.en: Combine an equilibrium spring, Maxwell branches and an optional dashpot.
description.zh: 组合平衡弹簧、Maxwell 分支与可选并联黏壶。

input.en: Moduli in Pa, relaxation times in s, viscosity in Pa·s.
input.zh: Pa 单位的模量、s 单位的松弛时间、Pa·s 单位的黏度。

output.en: Explicit constitutive record for supported history/dynamics routes.
output.zh: 供受支持历史或动力学路径使用的本构记录。

caveat.en: Numerical damping is not material viscosity; no calibration is implied.
caveat.zh: 数值阻尼不是材料黏度；该记录不代表已经完成材料标定。

description.en: Convert a supplied length between named units.
description.zh: 按指定的源单位与目标单位换算长度。

input.en: Value, from_unit and to_unit.
input.zh: 数值、from_unit 和 to_unit。

output.zh: 换算后的长度数值。

caveat.en: Does not rescale a graph, material, result or solver input automatically.
caveat.zh: 不会自动缩放图、材料、结果或求解器输入。

description.en: Translate stable-ID supports and forces into existing solver row controls.
description.zh: 将稳定 ID 的支座与节点力映射为已有求解器的行控制参数。

input.en: Graph, fixed_node_ids, forces_by_id and dimension.
input.zh: 图、fixed_node_ids、forces_by_id 和维度。

output.zh: PreparedNodalControls。

caveat.en: Reprepare after graph changes or reload; no unit conversion or model equivalence.
caveat.zh: 图修改或重新读取后须重新准备；不换算单位，也不保证不同模型等价。

description.en: Retain graph binding and expose Taichi/FEM row-ordered keyword arguments.
description.zh: 保留图绑定，并提供 Taichi、FEM 的行序关键字参数。

input.en: Factory output from prepare_nodal_controls.
input.zh: prepare_nodal_controls 的返回值。

output.zh: taichi_kwargs(graph)、fem_kwargs(graph) 与来源记录。

caveat.en: The provenance dictionary is not an executable restart checkpoint.
caveat.zh: 来源记录不是可执行的重启检查点。

title.zh: 含身份映射的力学结果

description.en: Carry displacements, edge response and backend-specific metadata.
description.zh: 保存位移、边响应与后端专属元数据。

input.en: Supported spring, FEM or LAMMPS producer output.
input.zh: 受支持的弹簧、FEM 或 LAMMPS 路径输出。

output.en: Result arrays, identity maps and optional detailed JSON.
output.zh: 结果数组、身份映射与可选详细 JSON。

caveat.en: Energy/force meanings differ by model; save() defaults to summary, not restart state.
caveat.zh: 不同模型的能量与力含义不同；save() 默认保存摘要，不是重启状态。

description.en: Keep geometry, physical-edge identity, directed messages and optional provenance aligned.
description.zh: 对齐保存几何、物理边身份、双向消息及可选来源信息。

input.en: Validated graph_batch output.
input.zh: graph_batch 校验后的输出。

output.en: Read-only numerical snapshot for adapters and learning inputs.
output.zh: 供接口和学习输入使用的只读数值快照。

caveat.en: A derived view, not a second editable graph or a full graph persistence format.
caveat.zh: 它是派生视图，不是第二套可编辑图，也不是完整图存储格式。

description.en: Dispatch supported combinations of backend, loading protocol and material controls.
description.zh: 分派受支持的后端、加载方式与材料控制组合。

input.en: StructureGraph, explicit backend/mode and route-specific controls.
input.zh: StructureGraph、明确的 backend/mode 及对应控制参数。

output.en: SimResult or ViscoelasticResult, according to route.
output.zh: 按路径返回 SimResult 或 ViscoelasticResult。

caveat.en: stretch_ratio=1.01 means 1% extension; omitted ratio retains 2.0. Spring/taichi defaults to geometry_policy='reject_internal_points'; explicit 'endpoint_chord' ignores edge interior points mechanically, not curved-fiber mechanics. Backends are not interchangeable.
caveat.zh: stretch_ratio=1.01 表示 1% 伸长；省略时仍为 2.0。spring/taichi 默认采用 geometry_policy='reject_internal_points'；显式选择 'endpoint_chord' 会在力学计算中忽略边内部点，并不提供曲纤维力学。各后端不能任意互换。

description.en: Run the Taichi axial-spring route with explicit device and physical inputs.
description.zh: 采用明确设备与物理输入运行 Taichi 轴向弹簧路径。

input.en: Graph, coefficients, masses, supports, forces and time controls.
input.zh: 图、系数、质量、支座、力和时间控制。

output.zh: 包含所选历史或状态记录的 SimResult。

caveat.en: Both dynamics() and stretch_test() default to geometry_policy='reject_internal_points'; explicit 'endpoint_chord' ignores edge interior points mechanically, not curved-fiber mechanics. Requires the supported Taichi runtime; imports do not prove readiness or GPU speedup.
caveat.zh: dynamics() 和 stretch_test() 均默认采用 geometry_policy='reject_internal_points'；显式选择 'endpoint_chord' 会在力学计算中忽略边内部点，并不提供曲纤维力学。需要受支持的 Taichi 运行时；导入成功不证明运行就绪或 GPU 加速效果。

description.en: Expose raw beam-frame solves and an explicit 2D viscoelastic history route.
description.zh: 提供梁框架原始求解与明确的二维黏弹性历史路径。

input.en: E/nu or history material, geometry, DOF constraints and loads.
input.zh: E/nu 或历史材料、几何、自由度约束与载荷。

output.en: Raw frame results, SimResult adapter or ViscoelasticResult.
output.zh: 原始框架结果、SimResult 转换结果或 ViscoelasticResult。

caveat.en: 3D stretch is linear-only; raw row controls and stable-ID history controls differ.
caveat.zh: 三维拉伸只支持线性；原始行控制与稳定 ID 历史控制不同。

description.en: Run the shared NumPy axial, degree-2 bending and node-contact model.
description.zh: 运行共享的 NumPy 轴向、二度节点弯曲与节点接触简化模型。

input.en: Graph in one XY plane, with straight edges and empty internal_points; ReducedBeamConfig.
input.zh: 位于同一 XY 平面的图，边为直线且 internal_points 为空；ReducedBeamConfig。

output.en: ReducedBeamResult: frames, edge strain, force curve and energy records.
output.zh: ReducedBeamResult：帧、边应变、力曲线和能量记录。

caveat.en: Represent stored curve points as actual graph nodes and straight edges before this route; no automatic conversion occurs. A reduced model, not a general nonlinear beam/contact solver.
caveat.zh: 采用此路径前，应将存储的曲线点表示为实际图节点与直边，不会自动转换。这是简化模型，不是通用非线性梁或接触求解器。

description.en: Solve the resistor network with explicit edge conductance and voltage boundaries.
description.zh: 用显式边电导与电压边界求解电阻网络。

input.en: Graph, conductance_S by edge ID, node voltages, length_unit.
input.zh: 图、按边 ID 给出的 conductance_S、节点电压、length_unit。

output.en: LinearTransportResult with ID-aligned voltages, currents and power.
output.zh: 含 ID 对齐电压、电流和功率的 LinearTransportResult。

caveat.en: Conductance is supplied in S, not inferred from conductivity S/m; floating components reject.
caveat.zh: 输入是 S 单位的边电导，不从 S/m 电导率推断；浮置分量会被拒绝。

description.en: Transfer an existing electrical result into transient thermal evolution.
description.zh: 将已有电求解结果作为热源，计算瞬态温度演化。

input.en: Original graph, electrical_result, J/K capacities, W/K conductances, initial temperatures, times_s, mandatory endpoint_weights and length_unit.
input.zh: 原始 graph、electrical_result、J/K 热容、W/K 热导、初始温度、times_s，以及必填的 endpoint_weights 和 length_unit。

output.en: JouleHeatingRun with heat_load and thermal result.
output.zh: 含 heat_load 与热结果的 JouleHeatingRun。

caveat.en: One-way coupling: temperature is not fed back into electrical conductance.
caveat.zh: 单向耦合：温度不会反向更新电导。

title.zh: 准备有界 LAMMPS 模型

description.en: Compile a declared 3D bead-and-harmonic-bond model without starting a native run.
description.zh: 编译明确指定的三维珠粒—谐键模型，不启动原生运行。

input.en: Graph, length_unit, maximum_bond_length_m, masses_kg, HarmonicBond maps and RunSpec; optional controls and bounded profile.
input.zh: Graph、length_unit、maximum_bond_length_m、masses_kg、HarmonicBond 映射及 RunSpec；可选控制项与有界 profile。

output.en: PreparedRun containing model and identity records.
output.zh: 包含模型与身份记录的 PreparedRun。

caveat.en: Straight, nonperiodic 3D geometry; no automatic chemistry or material-to-force-field conversion.
caveat.zh: 限直边、非周期三维几何；不自动生成化学模型或将材料转换为力场。

description.en: Manage the explicit one-shot native CLI lifecycle and parse its bounded outputs.
description.zh: 管理明确的一次性原生 CLI 生命周期并解析有界输出。

input.en: PreparedRun, RuntimeSpec, owned workdir and ResourceLimits.
input.zh: PreparedRun、RuntimeSpec、专用工作目录与 ResourceLimits。

output.en: Task state and LAMMPSRunResult after successful completion.
output.zh: 任务状态及成功完成后的 LAMMPSRunResult。

caveat.en: Runtime readiness and physical qualification require separate evidence; construction does not run the engine.
caveat.zh: 运行就绪与物理适用性需要独立证据；构造对象不会运行引擎。

description.en: Extract the legacy 94-feature schema with explicit status through extract_with_status().
description.zh: 通过 extract_with_status() 取得旧版 94 特征及其状态。

input.en: Supported graph and raster/extraction settings.
input.zh: 受支持的图与栅格、提取参数。

output.en: Values plus schema, parameters and per-feature status.
output.zh: 数值、模式、参数与逐特征状态。

caveat.en: Only 63 names are covered by the availability contract; missing dependencies are not measured zeros.
caveat.zh: 可用性约定覆盖其中 63 项；缺少依赖不等于测得零值。

description.en: Measure structure, planar pores and optional finite-width overlap in a bounded snapshot.
description.zh: 在给定规模内测量结构、平面孔隙与可选有限宽度重叠。

input.en: Planar straight-edge graph or positions and dense-row edges; optional region/contact settings.
input.zh: 平面直边图，或坐标与稠密行边数组；可选区域与接触设置。

output.zh: 快照特征字典。

caveat.en: For StructureGraph inputs, extract_graph rejects nonempty edge internal_points. Represent sampled paths as graph nodes joined by straight edges; this changes node/edge counts. Shares the caller's length units; not the legacy 94-feature schema.
caveat.zh: extract_graph 要求 StructureGraph 的边不含非空 internal_points。采样路径需显式表示为图节点和直边，这会改变节点数与边数。沿用调用方的长度单位；不是旧版 94 特征模式。

description.en: Measure topology on the authoritative physical-edge graph.
description.zh: 基于主结构图中的物理边统计拓扑。

input.en: StructureGraph.
input.zh: StructureGraph。

output.zh: TopologyMetricsV1。

caveat.en: Topology measurements do not establish stiffness, equilibrium or material response.
caveat.zh: 拓扑度量不能证明刚度、平衡或材料响应。

description.en: Measure XYZ chord/polyline lengths and selected undirected shortest paths.
description.zh: 测量 XYZ 弦长、折线长及指定节点对的无向最短路径。

input.en: Graph, explicit length_unit/frame, node pairs and distance_mode.
input.zh: 图、明确的长度单位与坐标系、节点对和 distance_mode。

output.zh: GeometryPathMetricsV1。

caveat.en: Polyline means stored points, not an inferred smooth curve; budgets are explicit.
caveat.zh: 折线指已保存点列，不是推断的光滑曲线；规模预算需明确。

description.en: Track positive-strain edge recruitment and grip-connected paths across frames.
description.zh: 逐帧分析正应变边的招募与夹持端间连通路径。

input.en: Frame×edge strain, aligned edges, grip rows and threshold controls.
input.zh: 帧×边应变、对齐边数组、夹持节点行号和阈值参数。

output.zh: PercolationResult。

caveat.en: Keep strain columns and edge rows aligned; thresholds define recruitment rather than a new constitutive law.
caveat.zh: 应变列与边行必须对齐；阈值定义招募规则，不是新的本构定律。

description.en: Snapshot graphs with physical-edge identity and both message directions intact.
description.zh: 保留物理边身份及双向消息，生成图的独立快照。

input.en: Graphs, graph_ids, units/frame, optional edge features/provenance.
input.zh: 图集合、graph_ids、单位与坐标系、可选边特征和来源记录。

output.zh: GraphBatch v1 或含来源记录的 v2。

caveat.en: Does not infer labels, mechanical constraints or numerical material features.
caveat.zh: 不推断标签、力学约束或数值材料特征。

description.en: Store samples, feature selections, targets and provenance with matching persistence APIs.
description.zh: 用配套读写接口保存样本、特征选择、目标和来源信息。

input.en: DatasetSample records, feature_names and target_names.
input.zh: DatasetSample 记录、feature_names 与 target_names。

output.en: Selected matrices, splits and saved dataset files.
output.zh: 所选矩阵、数据划分和保存的数据集文件。

caveat.en: Use feature_matrix_checked() for the explicit availability policy; ordinary matrices retain legacy behavior.
caveat.zh: 显式可用性检查使用 feature_matrix_checked()；普通矩阵仍沿用原有行为。

description.en: Generate bounded planar samples using the shared reduced-solver workflow.
description.zh: 通过共享简化求解流程生成受限规模的平面样本。

input.en: Planar configuration, seed, mode, acquisition policy and optional cache path.
input.zh: 平面配置、种子、模式、采样策略和可选缓存路径。

output.en: X: 14 features; Y: maximum force, stiffness and force–stretch work.
output.zh: X：14 个特征；Y：最大力、刚度与力—伸长比积分。

caveat.en: Labels belong to the configured reduced model, not universal material properties.
caveat.zh: 标签属于所配置的简化模型，不是通用材料属性。

description.en: Compute endpoint-based planar structural descriptors with NumPy.
description.zh: 用 NumPy 计算基于端点的平面结构描述符。

input.en: Finite positions and integer dense-row endpoint pairs.
input.zh: 有限坐标与整数稠密行端点对。

output.zh: 14 维 float64 特征向量。

caveat.en: Input edges use row indices, not arbitrary stable IDs.
caveat.zh: 输入边使用行索引，不是任意稳定 ID。

description.en: Train a three-target regressor with training-only normalization and held-out rows.
description.zh: 用仅训练集拟合的归一化与留出行训练三目标回归模型。

input.en: train(X, Y): at least five finite sample rows in X and a matching three-column target matrix Y.
input.zh: train(X, Y)：X 至少包含五行有限样本，Y 为行数对应的三列目标矩阵。

output.en: Fitted predictor, training history and held-out information.
output.zh: 拟合后的预测器、训练历史与留出信息。

caveat.en: Performance depends on the dataset and split; API presence does not establish accuracy.
caveat.zh: 性能取决于数据和划分；API 存在不代表预测精度已获验证。

description.en: Search graph-builder parameters with a fixed evaluation budget.
description.zh: 在固定评估预算内搜索图构建参数。

input.en: Construct with factory_builder(unit, pert, line_displacements) -> graph, optional unit_keys and budget. Call .run(target_name=..., evaluator=...) using `J`, `C`, `linear`, `max_peak`, `min_peak`, `max_stiffness`, `min_stiffness` or `max_toughness`.
input.zh: 构造时传入 factory_builder(unit, pert, line_displacements) -> graph，可选 unit_keys 和预算。调用 .run(target_name=..., evaluator=...) 时选择 `J`、`C`、`linear`、`max_peak`、`min_peak`、`max_stiffness`、`min_stiffness` 或 `max_toughness`。

output.zh: 搜索记录与当前最优候选。

caveat.en: Target-curve arrays are not accepted. Supply unit_keys at construction or fixed_unit to .run(). evaluator(graph, target_name) must return (objective_to_minimize, run), with a finite scalar objective; lower is better. Negate a custom maximization score before returning it. A best-found candidate is not a global-optimum or fabrication guarantee.
caveat.zh: 不接受目标曲线数组。构造时提供 unit_keys，或向 .run() 提供 fixed_unit。evaluator(graph, target_name) 必须返回 (objective_to_minimize, run)，其中目标值须为有限标量，越小越好；自定义最大化分数应先取负再返回。当前最优候选不代表全局最优或制造可行性保证。

description.en: Train through the optional SB3 wrapper using a caller-managed compatible environment.
description.zh: 通过可选 SB3 包装器，在调用方管理的兼容环境中训练策略。

input.en: Environment, algorithm, time-step budget and optional independent eval_env.
input.zh: 环境、算法、步数预算与可选独立 eval_env。

output.en: Trained policy model and training metadata.
output.zh: 训练后的策略模型与训练元数据。

caveat.en: The caller supplies the physical evaluator; this is distinct from fibernet.train_rl.
caveat.zh: 物理评估器由调用方提供；此接口与 fibernet.train_rl 不同。

description.en: Preserve the old random-rollout name; it does not train a policy.
description.zh: 保留旧的随机采样入口名称，不训练策略。

input.en: Historical env_config and episode count.
input.zh: 历史 env_config 与回合数。

output.en: Current built-in E*/ν* path raises NotImplementedError before simulation.
output.zh: 当前内置 E*/ν* 路径在模拟前抛出 NotImplementedError。

caveat.en: Unavailable: installing optional dependencies does not enable this built-in route.
caveat.zh: 当前不可用：安装可选依赖也不能启用这条内置路径。

description.en: Configure the package's shared planar topology and deformation controls.
description.zh: 配置库中共享的平面拓扑与几何变形参数。

input.en: Unit, grid, seed, displacement spectrum and topology.
input.zh: 基元、网格数、种子、位移谱和拓扑。

output.zh: 供 compile_planar()/manufacturable_graph() 使用的配置。

caveat.en: The unit-cell scale is 10 in input coordinates; a route constraint is not printability certification.
caveat.zh: 输入坐标的基元尺度为 10；满足路径约束不等于通过可打印性验证。

description.en: Build the shared manufacturing topology from its configuration/factory.
description.zh: 从配置或工厂构建共享的制造拓扑。

input.en: Planar configuration/factory and boundary_twins option.
input.zh: 平面配置或工厂及 boundary_twins 选项。

output.zh: ManufacturingNetwork。

caveat.en: This generator may build its own topology; use graph adapters to retain an existing graph unchanged.
caveat.zh: 该生成器会构建自己的拓扑；保留已有图不变应使用图适配接口。

description.en: Map closed units to a validated quadrilateral surface mesh.
description.zh: 将闭合基元映射到通过校验的四边形曲面网格。

input.en: 3D vertices, quad faces, configuration/factory and overscale.
input.zh: 三维顶点、四边形面、配置或工厂及 overscale。

output.zh: 曲面 ManufacturingNetwork。

caveat.en: Shares only prescribed mesh-corner identities; budgets and geometry checks apply.
caveat.zh: 仅共享规定的网格角点身份；须满足规模预算和几何检查。

title.en: Preserve a graph in a closed route

description.en: Adapt an existing connected, all-even graph without topology repair.
description.zh: 将已有连通、全偶度图转换为路径，不修补拓扑。

input.en: StructureGraph, graph_id, explicit m/mm and coordinate frame.
input.zh: StructureGraph、graph_id、明确的 m/mm 单位与坐标系。

output.zh: (ManufacturingNetwork, GraphBatch v2 快照)。

caveat.en: Nonempty edge interior points reject; IDs, material and radius provenance stay attached.
caveat.zh: 拒绝非空边内点；保留 ID、材料和半径来源记录。

title.zh: 导出带映射的闭合路径

description.en: Write a millimetre-coordinate CSV and stable-ID JSON sidecar.
description.zh: 输出毫米坐标 CSV 与稳定 ID 映射 JSON。

input.en: Bound network/snapshot pair and two fresh destination paths.
input.zh: 绑定的 network/snapshot 对与两个全新目标路径。

output.en: CSV, sidecar and returned mapping metadata.
output.zh: CSV、配套 JSON 与返回的映射元数据。

caveat.en: CSV legacy IDs are dense rows; the sidecar resolves stable IDs. Not G-code or machine qualification.
caveat.zh: CSV 旧列名中的 ID 为稠密行号，稳定 ID 由 JSON 映射；不是 G-code 或设备认证。

title.zh: 物理边仅走一次的多段路径

description.en: Route connected odd-degree graphs without adding physical fibers.
description.zh: 为连通的奇度图生成多段路径，不添加物理纤维。

input.en: Connected nonempty graph, graph_id, explicit m/mm and frame.
input.zh: 连通非空图、graph_id、明确的 m/mm 单位与坐标系。

output.zh: (ManufacturingTrails, GraphBatch v2 快照)。

caveat.en: Stroke breaks are discontinuities; no travel segment is generated between them.
caveat.zh: 分段处是明确断点，不会自动生成段间行程。

title.zh: 导出带映射的多段路径

description.en: Write stroke-aware mm CSV and complete stable-ID JSON mapping.
description.zh: 输出含分段信息的毫米 CSV 与完整稳定 ID JSON 映射。

input.en: Bound trails/snapshot pair and two fresh destination paths.
input.zh: 绑定的 trails/snapshot 对与两个全新目标路径。

output.en: Stroke CSV, JSON sidecar and mapping metadata.
output.zh: 分段 CSV、配套 JSON 和映射元数据。

caveat.en: No connection between strokes; valid sidecar plus matching CSV hash records completion.
caveat.zh: 各段之间没有连接；有效 JSON 与匹配 CSV 哈希共同表示导出完成。

description.en: Serialize the native graph record before opening the destination.
description.zh: 在打开目标文件前完成原生图记录序列化。

input.en: StructureGraph and a destination with an existing parent.
input.zh: StructureGraph 与父目录已存在的目标路径。

output.zh: 原生图 JSON 文件。

caveat.en: Not an atomic filesystem transaction or solver restart checkpoint.
caveat.zh: 不是原子文件事务，也不是求解器重启检查点。

description.en: Reconstruct a graph from the matching native JSON schema.
description.zh: 从配套的原生 JSON 模式重建图。

input.en: Native StructureGraph JSON path.
input.zh: 原生 StructureGraph JSON 路径。

output.zh: StructureGraph。

caveat.en: Rebuild prepared row controls after reload; do not assume old insertion order.
caveat.zh: 重新读取后须重新准备行控制，不能假设仍是旧的插入顺序。

description.en: Export a detached MultiGraph carrying the native-v1 records.
description.zh: 导出携带 native-v1 记录的独立 MultiGraph。

input.en: StructureGraph.
input.zh: StructureGraph。

output.en: NetworkX MultiGraph with stable identities and ordering records.
output.zh: 含稳定身份与顺序记录的 NetworkX MultiGraph。

caveat.en: Round-trip through from_networkx_lossless; arbitrary NetworkX topology edits are outside this protocol.
caveat.zh: 通过 from_networkx_lossless 回读；任意 NetworkX 拓扑编辑不在该协议范围内。

description.en: Select the 2D or 3D renderer from the declared graph dimension.
description.zh: 按图声明的维度选择二维或三维绘制器。

input.en: StructureGraph, theme and optional image path.
input.zh: StructureGraph、主题与可选图片路径。

output.en: Matplotlib Figure and optional saved image.
output.zh: Matplotlib Figure 与可选保存的图片。

caveat.en: Renderer options differ by dimension; no simulation is performed.
caveat.zh: 不同维度的绘制参数不同；该调用不进行模拟。

description.en: Render original and deformed graphs side by side.
description.zh: 并排绘制原始与变形后的结构图。

input.en: Two graphs; optional displacement array and node_ids.
input.zh: 两张图；可选位移数组与 node_ids。

output.zh: Matplotlib Figure。

caveat.en: Caller supplies the deformed graph and identity-aligned data; plotting is not a solve.
caveat.zh: 变形图与身份对齐数据由调用方提供；绘图不是求解。

label.zh: 通过 fem_kwargs(graph) 传入原始求解

label.en: geometry input; spring/taichi defaults to reject_internal_points; explicit endpoint_chord is endpoint-only
label.zh: 几何输入；spring/taichi 默认采用 reject_internal_points；显式 endpoint_chord 只计算端点弦

label.en: one XY plane; reject nonempty internal_points; caller supplies graph nodes and straight edges first
label.zh: 同一 XY 平面；拒绝非空 internal_points；调用方需先准备实际图节点与直边
提取对齐的应变、边与夹持数组

label.en: wrap values and feature_contract metadata in DatasetSample records
label.zh: 将特征值与 feature_contract 元数据封装为 DatasetSample 记录
已保存的 XYZ 几何

label.en: stack 14-element vectors into X rows; supply matching Y labels
label.zh: 将 14 维向量逐行组成 X，并提供对应的 Y 标签
允许奇度节点的连通图
配套原生 JSON 文件
携带原生记录的 MultiGraph 视图
原图与调用方提供的变形图
